market_definition: The two-component epoxy adhesives market comprises adhesives supplied as separate resin and hardener parts that cure after mixing at ambient or elevated temperature. It measures sales of finished kits and bulk systems for structural, repair and industrial bonding. BY HARDENER TYPE: Amine, Polyamide, Anhydride, Other Hardeners. BY CURE SPEED: Rapid-Set, Standard-Set, Slow-Set / Long Pot Life. BY PACKAGING FORMAT: Dual Cartridges, Bulk Kits, Retail Syringes & Tubes. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Wind Energy & Marine, Building & Construction, Industrial Assembly & Machinery, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: One-component epoxy adhesives; structural acrylic adhesives; epoxy flooring, coatings and potting compounds; standalone epoxy resins and hardeners. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
